conflicts.title: smile_4876
conflicts.chosen: A woman in a yellow raincoat stands under a glass bus shelter in the rain, eyes squeezed shut and teeth showing in a wide smile, while a golden retriever puppy tucked inside her open jacket licks her chin. Behind her two other people wait for the bus with flat, miserable faces, staring down at the wet pavement. Warm yellow shop windows glow behind the rain-streaked glass.

others.value: A woman in a denim jacket stands among stadium seats, mouth wide open, shouting and clapping. The camera pulls back to show the people around her on their feet doing the same, then keeps pulling back until a whole floodlit stadium of tens of thousands is shouting and applauding together.
